Hello Support Team,
I have shipped the defective miner back to you as requested under my order ORDER Shop····.
The package is currently stuck in the US with DHL (Tracking Number: ····) because a customs duty/payment of 125.38 USD is required, and DHL has noted that the recipient could not be reached.
Please take care of this shipment immediately, contact DHL to pay the required fees, and coordinate the delivery. Your email address and contact details are already provided in the customs documents.
Since my shipping provider's deadline is October 23, 2026, prompt action is required to prevent the package from being returned or destroyed.
Thank you for your quick assistance.
Best regards
I'll pull your order and return up now.

Two things, and the first one matters most.

That DHL email is almost certainly a scam. Real duty notices don't come as a "Click Here to Pay" image, and it's addressed to a company name that isn't yours or ours. Please don't click the link or call that number, and don't pay it.

Second, I can't see a return or a return label on Shop···· on our side, so I want to get this right rather than guess. Who arranged the return with you, and do you have the label we sent?

I've pinged the team now. Stay in the chat and one of them will jump in.

Hi Sarah, thanks for your response. However, I can assure you this is not a scam:
1. My shipping provider (JUMINGO) directly informed me that the carrier is unable to reach you and that local contact details/action are required.
2. The official DHL Express tracking for number (phone hidden) also clearly shows that the package is held in US customs awaiting duty payment / local response.
3. As confirmed in our official PayPal dispute case, this defect return was authorized and sent back to you.
Please contact DHL Express US directly with tracking number ···· (or call their Duty Team at (phone hidden)) to pay the customs fees and accept the delivery before the October 23 deadline.

Understood, and thanks for the detail, that helps.

Paying a customs bill isn't something I can do from here, so I've put it in front of the team with the tracking number, the $125.38 figure and your October 23 deadline. Because there's a case open on this order, they're the ones who can act on it, and they're on right now.

Stay in the chat and one of them will come in. If you step away, the answer comes to your email.

Thank you! Once you check the tracking number ···· directly on the official DHL website, you will see the exact status yourself.
Best regards,
Jörg S.

Will do, Jörg. I've passed the tracking number along with everything else, so the team can check it on DHL's side and deal with the duty bill directly.

Nothing else is needed from you right now. Stay in the chat if you can, one of them will come in here, and if you step away the answer reaches your email.
Thank you very much Sarah

You're welcome, Jörg. It's with the team now and they know the October 23 date matters.

A copy of this whole conversation comes to your email once we're done here, so you'll have the tracking number and everything we covered in writing.

Here is the receipt/invoice for the €86 return shipping costs since the item was delivered defective. Please confirm the reimbursement of this amount along with my full order refund.
Thank you

Refunds and reimbursements aren't mine to confirm, so I won't give you a figure I can't stand behind. I've added the €86.56 invoice and your refund request to what's already with the team, alongside the duty bill.

They're on now. Stay in the chat if you can and one of them will come in here with the answer, otherwise it reaches your email.
Perfect. I'll leave this open for them, Jörg. If anything else comes in from DHL or JUMiNGO in the meantime, drop it here and it goes straight onto the same case.
